title: Alpine Lake and Lone Pine in Mountains, 1920s Scenic B&W Vintage Photo
description: A vertical alpine wilderness view captured in stark monochrome contrast. In the foreground, a prominent evergreen tree stands in deep silhouette along the shadowed shoreline of a serene mountain lake. Near the water's edge, a small rowboat rests beside the shore. Across the lake, a dense evergreen forest borders the foothills below steep mountain slopes marked with melting snow fields beneath a soft, hazy sky. The reverse features a faint diagonal pattern with a single blue/purple stamped number '48'.
